$comment: Design tokens (spec 052 §B6). The SOURCE of the app's palette, scales and z-order. scripts/build_tokens.py regenerates the :root block in static/css/theme.css and design/Tokens.swift from this file; do not edit either of those by hand. tests/unit/test_design_tokens_052.py fails if they drift.

groups.comment: Bootstrap palette, theme surfaces and text

tokens.name: color-scheme
tokens.comment: Dark-only app: render native controls (selects, scrollbars, pickers) dark

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.comment: The wordmark's own green, sampled from static/images/logo3-1.png. The accent family below is this hue (119deg) lifted for a dark background — at 3.7:1 on --bg-color the mark's own green is fine as a mark and too dark for text.

tokens.name: logo-green-soft
tokens.comment: The logo hue at the legibility the old grey had (4.9:1, same as #888): resting tab-bar labels and anywhere else that wants the brand colour without shouting.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.comment: Accent TEXT, links, icons and thin borders. The logo hue at 6.9:1 on --bg-color, which is where the blue it replaced sat (6.8:1). It is too light to sit BEHIND white text — that is --primary-fill's job.

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.comment: Accent FILL: every surface that carries white text — a selected filter, a tune-type chip, a primary button. The logo green itself, sampled from logo3-1.png, which is one flat #4a8049. White on it is 4.69:1; white on the lighter --primary was 2.54:1, under AA, and read as the washed-out green a phone uses for the messages it does not want you to like.

tokens.name: font-family-sans-serif
tokens.value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

tokens.name: font-family-monospace
tokens.value: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

tokens.name: site-header-h
tokens.comment: The site header is position:fixed at this height on every width, so anything that sticks to the top of the viewport has to start BELOW it or it slides underneath and disappears. Named here rather than repeated as a magic 42.

tokens.name: bg-color
tokens.comment: Theme surface/text variables (the app is dark-only)

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.comment: Muted text (formerly a phantom var)

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.comment: Hover-state darks (formerly phantom vars; values match the fallbacks in use)

tokens.name: primary-fill-hover
tokens.comment: --primary-fill hovered: 10% darker. White text 5.57:1, and still 3.12:1 against the page, so a hovered chip does not sink into the background. --primary-dark is NOT this — it is lighter than --primary-fill, so using it here would brighten on hover.

tokens.name: already-added-bg
tokens.comment: Already-added rows in tune search

tokens.name: modal-bg-secondary
tokens.comment: Modal surfaces (moved from tune_detail_modal.css so load order doesn't matter)

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.comment: Radius

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.comment: Shadow: sm = dropdowns, md = cards, lg = modals/sheets

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.comment: Scrim behind modals/sheets

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.comment: Spacing: 4px base scale

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.comment: Motion

tokens.name: z-background
tokens.comment: Tier 1: component layering (1-10)

tokens.name: z-bootstrap-dropdown
tokens.comment: Tier 2: reserved for Bootstrap framework elements — do not reuse

tokens.name: z-modal-overlay
tokens.comment: Tier 3: application UI. Modals sit BELOW the header (2000) on purpose, so the hamburger menu stays accessible while a modal is open.

tokens.name: z-sheet-overlay
tokens.comment: Kit Sheet/Dialog (spec 035): full-screen sheet chrome carries its own header (Cancel/title/Done), so unlike the legacy modals it must cover the fixed header. Search dropdowns (2100) still float above sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.comment: Tier 4: top layer — toasts only
